title: Brand Claim Subsidiary
description: A brand claim that a domain is a subsidiary, with the subsidiary domain, an optional brand ID, and the time the claim was observed.

subsidiary_domain.description: Domain of the leaf brand whose `house_domain` claim is being verified.

subsidiary_brand_id.description: Stable brand identifier the leaf uses for itself. Optional but recommended.

observed_at.description: When the caller observed the leaf's claim.
